name: Hanwha Solutions Corporation
summary: Hanwha Solutions Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resins in South Korea, China, Germany, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Basic Materials, Renewable Energy, Processed Materials, and Other segments. It produces and sells PE, PVC, CA, TDI products, etc.; hydrogenated petroleum resin; specialized products, such as insulator XLPE, high-purity XDI for use in high-refractive lenses and plasticizers; and solar ingots and wafers, as well as cells and modules.
